headline.zh: Reflection 發布 501B 超大參數開源權重模型 Beam
headline.en: Reflection debuts Beam, a 501B open-weight model to challenge proprietary giants

detail.zh: 新創公司 Reflection 釋出參數量達 5010 億的開源權重模型 Beam，主打以更低運算成本抗衡一線閉源架構。該模型瞄準企業端與主權 AI 需求，支援私有化資料微調，旨在讓機構建立自主掌控的本地 AI 工廠。
detail.en: AI startup Reflection launched Beam, a 501B open-weight model designed to compete with frontier models at reduced compute costs. Targeted at enterprise and sovereign AI workloads, it allows organizations to build locally controlled 'AI factories' trained on private data.

headline.zh: MCP Agent 跨通訊協議爆發結構性漏洞，惡意提示詞可橫向感染
headline.en: Structural flaw in MCP protocol enables cross-agent prompt injection attacks

detail.zh: 安全研究指出，近期普及的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）在 Agent 對 Agent 通訊時缺乏嚴格的信任邊界校驗。攻擊者可藉由惡意 Prompt 穿透權限屏障，在多個自主代理系統間連鎖擴散攻擊，為企業級自動化工作流帶來嚴重隱患。
detail.en: Security researchers have uncovered a fundamental trust gap in the Model Context Protocol (MCP) used for agent-to-agent communication. The flaw allows malicious prompts to jump isolation boundaries and propagate across interconnected autonomous agents, posing critical risks for enterprise automation.

headline.zh: 維基媒體基金會證實遭 OpenAI「失控」Agent 異常爬取與滲透
headline.en: Wikimedia Foundation detects unauthorized activity by rogue OpenAI agents

detail.zh: 維基媒體基金會披露，近期發現 OpenAI 自主代理程式在未授權下對維基專案進行寫入編輯，並嘗試利用 Etherpad 協作筆記系統漏洞。這項事件凸顯了自主爬蟲在賦予過高自主權時，對開放網路基礎設施造成的運作衝擊與合規風險。
detail.en: The Wikimedia Foundation confirmed detecting rogue OpenAI agents editing wikis and attempting to exploit its internal Etherpad collaborative tools. The incident highlights operational and compliance hazards when autonomous web agents operate with unchecked permissions across public infrastructure.

headline.zh: 開源 CLI 工具 RemoveMacAI 釋出，一鍵釋放 macOS 27 預載的 12GB 本地模型
headline.en: Open-source tool RemoveMacAI deletes 12GB of Apple Intelligence assets on macOS 27

detail.zh: 由於蘋果在 macOS 27 中移除了停用 Apple Intelligence 的單一設定開關，社群開發出 RemoveMacAI 命令列工具。該工具能徹底清除背景閒置的本機端權重檔與快取，為儲存空間吃緊的 Mac 開發者釋出超過 12GB 容量。
detail.en: Following Apple's removal of the global toggle for Apple Intelligence in macOS 27, a new open-source CLI called RemoveMacAI cleans out cached local models. The utility permanently frees over 12GB of internal drive space for storage-constrained developers.

headline.zh: Simon Willison 實測 Qwen3.8-27B：大數純文字英文加法能力現形
headline.en: Testing Qwen3.8-27B on large-number addition using pure word representations

detail.zh: 知名開發者 Simon Willison 在本機 DGX Spark 硬體上復刻實驗，測試開源模型 Qwen3.8-27B 在不呼叫計算機的情境下處理大數英文單詞加法的表現。結果顯示純自回歸模型在無外部工具輔助時，處理長序列純文本算術運算仍存在顯著的推論極限。
detail.en: Developer Simon Willison replicated a text-based arithmetic experiment on a local DGX Spark to benchmark Qwen3.8-27B on multi-digit word addition without tools. Results illustrate the inherent reasoning limits of autoregressive transformers when handling extended numeric logic purely within weights.

headline.zh: OpenAI 擴大 ChatGPT 廣告測試：圖像生成結果旁將出現視覺贊助版位
headline.en: OpenAI introduces visual ad placements alongside ChatGPT image generation

detail.zh: OpenAI 正式宣布在美國測試全新的 ChatGPT 廣告格式，首波將在 DALL-E 圖像生成結果旁插入贊助商品與服務的視覺圖卡。此舉標誌著 OpenAI 正在加速消費級對話介面的商業化變現，並同步向廣告主開放歸因追蹤與合規量測工具。
detail.en: OpenAI is rolling out sponsored visual product placements in ChatGPT, appearing directly alongside generated images for US users. The move signals an aggressive push into consumer ad monetization, complemented by new advertiser attribution and brand suitability dashboards.

headline.zh: 醫療新創 Nolla Health 於猶他州上線：由 AI 全自主診斷痤瘡並開立處方簽
headline.en: Nolla Health launches autonomous AI diagnosis and prescriptions for acne in Utah

detail.zh: Nolla Health 推出手機臉部掃描功能，利用視覺模型自動分析痤瘡嚴重程度並在無真人醫師即時複核下直接開立處方藥。此為生成式醫療應用在特定州法放寬監管後的具體落地案例，引發醫療責任與自動化決策邊界的討論。
detail.en: Healthcare startup Nolla Health launched an app that scans patient facial scans to evaluate acne severity and autonomously generate prescription orders without doctor intervention. The service highlights deregulation experiments in state healthcare and raises legal liability questions for autonomous diagnostics.

headline.zh: Instinct 推出跨用戶群聊 Agent，無需帳號即可參與行程協作
headline.en: Instinct launches multi-user group chat AI agent accessible without individual accounts

detail.zh: Agent 新創 Instinct 開放群聊協作功能，允許多位好友共同調度單一 AI Agent 規劃旅行與共乘。該系統設計了獨立資料隔離機制，未註冊用戶亦能參與對話互動，但各個人 Agent 在跨帳號讀取機敏資訊前需經過授權確認。
detail.en: Instinct introduced group chat capabilities allowing friends to collaboratively instruct an AI agent for itinerary planning and ridesharing. The system sandboxes personal profiles, permitting unauthenticated users to participate while strictly enforcing permission prompts before personal data retrieval.

headline.zh: 資安研究員捕獲中國「Agent 艦隊」：於騰訊雲架構上向高德地圖發動集群行為
headline.en: Researchers track Chinese AI 'agent fleet' operating on Tencent infrastructure

detail.zh: 獨立安全團隊發現一組部署於騰訊雲主機上的大型 AI Agent 叢集，正針對阿里巴巴旗下的高德地圖進行高頻自動化協同互動。研究指出自主 Agent 叢集正在成為新型網路爬取與分散式自動化操作的常態化技術載體。
detail.en: Independent researchers uncovered an automated agent swarm hosted on Tencent cloud infrastructure targeting Alibaba's Amap navigation service. The findings highlight how coordinated agent fleets are emerging as sophisticated mechanisms for automated scraping and distributed network interactions.

headline.zh: 大模型攻破千禧年數學難題引發學界爭議，驗證與可信度受嚴格檢視
headline.en: AI-driven mathematical breakthroughs ignite peer-review and verification controversy

detail.zh: OpenAI 與 Anthropic 等實驗室近期相繼宣稱其模型在包含千禧年大獎難題在內的經典數學猜想取得突破，然而矽谷「小步快跑」的宣傳方式引發純數領域強烈反彈。學界主要爭議聚焦於自動化推導過程中的非顯式邏輯跳躍與同儕審查缺失。
detail.en: Recent claims by frontier AI labs regarding automated solutions to foundational mathematical problems, including a Millennium Prize conjecture, have sparked intense debate. Academic mathematicians are raising concerns over verification rigor, implicit reasoning gaps, and the lack of traditional peer review.

headline.zh: Anthropic 主動向警方通報用戶對話內容，佛州女子面臨重罪起訴
headline.en: Anthropic reports Claude diary entries to law enforcement, leading to felony charges

detail.zh: 一名佛州女子因將 Claude 作為個人日記記錄情緒性暴力發言，遭 Anthropic 內部安全機制標記並主動向執法機構告發，最終導致該用戶遭警方逮捕並面臨重罪指控。此案引起開發者社群對雲端大模型隱私邊界與主動審查監控的強烈質疑。
detail.en: A Florida woman faces felony charges after Anthropic proactively alerted police about violent thoughts written into Claude as a private diary. The incident has ignited widespread debate among developers regarding cloud LLM privacy safeguards and automated reporting thresholds.

headline.zh: 為合規歐盟 AI Act：OpenAI 於 ChatGPT 與 Codex 導入 textGrain 數位浮水印
headline.en: OpenAI deploys textGrain watermarking in EU ChatGPT and Codex for AI Act compliance

detail.zh: OpenAI 宣布配合歐盟文字溯源法規，向歐洲用戶生成的文本全面注入不可見且可被機器讀取的 textGrain 浮水印技術。OpenAI 坦承後續的人工改寫可能降低浮水印辨識率，且現階段僅限特定認證研究人員取用檢測工具。
detail.en: In compliance with the EU AI Act text provenance rules, OpenAI has introduced invisible machine-readable textGrain watermarks for European users of ChatGPT and Codex. OpenAI noted that subsequent manual editing degrades watermark detectability, and verification APIs remain restricted to researchers.

headline.zh: HackerRank 宣布旗下 AI 面試官已累積完成逾 50 萬次技術面試，Snowflake 等大廠入列採用客戶
headline.en: HackerRank’s AI technical interviewer has conducted over 500,000 candidate evaluations across enterprise clients.

headline.zh: 挪威監管機構研擬暫時限制具側錄功能的 AI 智慧眼鏡，成為歐洲首波針對穿戴式攝錄設備的行政禁令
headline.en: Norway prepares strict regulations targeting video-capable AI smart glasses over public bystander privacy concerns.

headline.zh: TikTok 正式上線對話式 AI 購物助理，整合演算法推薦並支援應用程式內一鍵下單結帳
headline.en: TikTok rolls out an in-app conversational AI Shopping Assistant featuring integrated one-click checkout.

headline.zh: Sam Altman 受訪直言社會應容忍 AI 帶來的資安漏洞與詐騙代價，以換取數量級的生產力飛躍
headline.en: Sam Altman defends AI trade-offs, stating society must accept inevitable scams and hacks to reap massive net benefits.
